name: FC200
summary: FC200 is a compact iToF depth-sensing module for cleaning robots. It provides depth and grayscale information for navigation and obstacle avoidance, with manufacturer-documented integration into the Horizon X3 development platform. Its flexible-circuit form factor and sub-watt average power support embedded installations.

sources.title: 奥比中光与地平线强强联手，引领机器人3D视觉感知核心应用开发
sources.quote: FC200模组深度图像输出分辨率为640*480@15fps，具备近距毫米级的检测精度，在0.1m-6m的工作距离，有效视场角高达110°，便于扫地机器人精准完成导航和避障两大核心视觉应用。模组平均功耗低于1W，整体发热量低，更适用于扫地机器人嵌入式接入。
